_meta.note: All keys mirror schemas.ts stable IDs. Diagnostic templates use mustache-style {var} placeholders matched to gate-diagnostic.failures[].vars.

diagnostic.MISSING_INPUT: required input source missing or unreadable: --input not provided OR stdin could not be read (--input - failed)
diagnostic.SPEC_EDIT_INPUT_REQUIRED: non-interactive `loaf spec edit` requires --input <src>; the editor lane requires TTY stdin and stdout
diagnostic.SPEC_LOCKED_NO_DIRECT_EDIT: {kind} blocked: spec_locked=true; use `loaf finding raise --category spec-gap --action amend-spec` to back-edge into SPEC.spec
diagnostic.SPEC_NOT_INITIALIZED: {kind} blocked: spec_version=0; run `loaf spec submit` first to bump spec_version to 1
diagnostic.SPEC_ALREADY_INITIALIZED: spec.md already exists at {spec_md_path}; refusing to overwrite
diagnostic.CONFIG_ALREADY_INITIALIZED: loaf config already exists at {config_path}; refusing to overwrite
diagnostic.ATTACHMENT_NOT_FILE: attachment path is not a regular file: {path} ({kind})
diagnostic.FINDING_ACTION_UNUSUAL_REASON_REQUIRED: finding category={category} × action={action} is 'unusual'; --reason of at least {min_reason_length} characters is required
diagnostic.FINDING_ACTION_INCOHERENT: finding category={category} × action={action} is incoherent: no target task exists to apply this transition to
diagnostic.PRUNE_RESTORE_NOT_FOUND: no trashed session matches the given id
diagnostic.PRUNE_RESTORE_AMBIGUOUS: the session id was trashed more than once; pass --at <ts> to pick one
diagnostic.PRUNE_RESTORE_INCOMPLETE: the trash bucket is incomplete (missing a required artifact); not restoring
diagnostic.PRUNE_PATH_OCCUPIED: a restore destination already exists; refusing to overwrite
diagnostic.PRUNE_PARTIAL_FAILURE: prune partially failed: one or more sessions could not be removed
diagnostic.MUTUALLY_EXCLUSIVE_FLAGS: mutually exclusive flags in the same invocation: {flags}
diagnostic.INVALID_ENV_VALUE: environment variable {env_name}={value} is not in the accepted enum: {accepted}
diagnostic.HOOK_EVENT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: hook event `{event}` is not implemented in this loaf version (Phase 16 SC-15{sub_cycle} pending; see protocol §11)
diagnostic.TASK_STATUS_WITHOUT_PROOF: task {task_id} status change requires evidence: status={status} has no PASSING covering evidence proof in evidence.jsonl
diagnostic.MISSING_VERIFIABILITY: REQ {req_id} must declare measurable, verified_by_scenarios[], or acceptance_na+reason
diagnostic.VAGUE_NO_SCENARIO: requirement {req_id} reads as vague but is not anchored to a measurable threshold or to a verifying scenario
diagnostic.DRIVES_NOT_BOUND: REQ {req_id} is not referenced by any task.drives[]
diagnostic.MUTATION_OUT_OF_RIGHTS: event:tasks_amended on task {task_id} is not permitted at sub_state {sub_state} — §8.6 grants no mutation right for this change
diagnostic.LOCK_TIMEOUT: could not acquire the write lock within {timeout_seconds}s
diagnostic.LOCK_INVALID: feature write lease at {lock_path} is malformed or incomplete
diagnostic.FEATURE_NOT_FOUND: no feature found in cwd (.loaf/ is empty or missing, or no projection has phase != DONE)
diagnostic.FEATURE_AMBIGUOUS: current working directory has {count} active features and no dispatch context: {feature_list}
diagnostic.SESSION_CWD_MISMATCH: --session {uuid} is registered against cwd={registered_cwd}, but the current cwd is {current_cwd}
diagnostic.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: --session {uuid_or_prefix} matches no entry in the registry
diagnostic.PENDING_BLOCKS_ADVANCE: pending head {pending_id} (kind={kind}) blocks `loaf advance` until resolved
diagnostic.GATE_NOT_PENDING: `loaf gate decide {gate_kind}` requires pending head kind=gate_decision; current head kind: {head_kind}
diagnostic.ESCALATION_NOT_PENDING: `loaf profile escalate --confirm --input <ceremony.json>` requires pending head kind=profile_escalation; current head: {actual_head}
diagnostic.ACTOR_AUTHORITY_VIOLATION: actor {actor} is not allowed for journal kind {kind}
diagnostic.FROM_CURSOR_MISMATCH: entry payload.from={payload_from} does not match current sub_state={current_sub_state}
diagnostic.SEQ_NOT_MONOTONIC: entry seq {got} does not extend journal tail {tail_seq}; expected {expected}
diagnostic.SETTLE_PHASE_BYPASS: VERIFY.accept → DONE.delivered requires ceremony.settle_phase=false (quick / light / standard); deep profile must enter SETTLE.lessons first; current settle_phase={settle_phase}
diagnostic.SETTLE_PHASE_DISABLED: VERIFY.accept → SETTLE.lessons requires ceremony.settle_phase=true (deep profile only after rev 5.x); current settle_phase={settle_phase}
diagnostic.SUB_STATE_AUTHORITY_VIOLATION: kind {kind} is not allowed in sub_state {sub_state}
diagnostic.EXECUTE_DONE_TASKS_NOT_FINAL: cannot advance EXECUTE.work → EXECUTE.done: {count} task(s) are not in a final status (done or abandoned); finish their remaining steps or abandon out-of-scope tasks with `loaf tasks abandon <T-N> --reason "..."`
diagnostic.ALREADY_STARTED: session bootstrap kind {kind} cannot run after state already exists
diagnostic.FINDING_NOT_FOUND: finding close references unknown finding id {id}
diagnostic.NO_SESSION: no started session — run `loaf start` first
diagnostic.REDUCER_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: reducer has no handler for journal kind {kind}
diagnostic.ENTRY_OVERSIZE: journal entry serialized to {bytes} bytes; limit is {limit}
diagnostic.NO_HUMAN_ACTOR: no human actor could be resolved for a human-only command
diagnostic.DUPLICATE_REQ_ID: REQ id {id} is already in the spec projection
diagnostic.DUPLICATE_SCEN_ID: SCEN id {id} is already in the spec projection
diagnostic.DUPLICATE_VIS_ID: VIS id {id} is already in the spec projection
diagnostic.SPEC_HAS_UNCLARIFIED: spec has {count} unresolved needs_clarification entries (ids={ids}); resolve or remove them before spec-lock can pass
diagnostic.TASK_NOT_FOUND: task {task_id} is not in the current tasks projection
diagnostic.TASK_STEP_NOT_FOUND: step {step} is not seeded on task {task_id} — seeded steps are derived from the task's kind execution schema (§14)
diagnostic.DUPLICATE_TASK_ID: task id {task_id} appears more than once in tasks_planned payload
diagnostic.TASKS_NOT_PLANNED: gate task-graph check: tasks have not been planned (snapshot.tasks_based_on is null)
diagnostic.TASKS_BASED_ON_STALE: gate task-graph check: tasks_based_on.spec={tasks_based_on_spec} but current spec.spec_version={current_spec_version} — the task graph was planned against an older spec
diagnostic.REQ_NOT_DRIVEN: spec-lock check 4: requirement {req_id} is not referenced by any task.drives[]
diagnostic.E2E_SCENARIO_UNBOUND: spec-lock check 6: e2e scenario {scenario_id} has no binding task (requires task with requires_acceptance=true AND drives includes {scenario_id})
diagnostic.VISUAL_CONTRACT_UNBOUND: spec-lock check 7: visual_contract {visual_id} has no visual-ui task whose visual_contract_refs includes it
diagnostic.TASK_KIND_SCHEMA_VIOLATION: spec-lock check 8: task {task_id} (kind={kind}) violates projected kind-specific obligations: {reasons}
diagnostic.GATE_PRECONDITION_VIOLATION: gate:decided {gate} approval rejected at the mutate layer: {failure_count} check(s) failed
diagnostic.MULTIPLE_GATE_DECISIONS: batch contains {count} approved gate:decided entries (gate_kinds={gate_kinds}); protocol §10.8 requires one gate decision per atomic operation
diagnostic.GATE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: gate={gate} is not recognized; protocol GateName enum is closed at `spec-lock` or `verify-accept` for v0.1.0
diagnostic.VERIFY_LANE_NOT_PASSED: verify-accept check 1: applicable VERIFY lane={lane} has no evidence with passing/approved/waived result
diagnostic.OPEN_FINDINGS_PRESENT: verify-accept check 2: {count} actionable finding(s) still open (ids={open_ids}); resolve or close before verify-accept
diagnostic.COVERAGE_NOT_SATISFIED: {covered_id} has no evidence that satisfies it (canSatisfy failed for all candidates)
diagnostic.TASK_DONE_NO_EVIDENCE: verify-accept check 4: task {task_id} is status=done but has no evidence covering it (kind one of `task-summary`, `local-check`, `manual`, or `waiver`)
diagnostic.SPEC_REVIEW_MISSING: verify-accept check 5: ceremony.strict_spec_review=true requires ≥1 evidence kind=spec-review with result `passed` or `approved` from an actor ≠ implementer; none found
diagnostic.SPEC_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTER_CONFLICT: verify-accept check 5: every passing spec-review actor is in the implementer set; no independent reviewer signed off (actors={spec_review_actors}, implementers={implementers})
diagnostic.SPEC_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTER_UNKNOWN: verify-accept check 5: cannot establish implementer set (all done-task evidence actors are cli:* automation); strict_spec_review fails closed
diagnostic.DELIVER_NOT_ACCEPTED: deliver requires verify_accepted=true at sub_state={sub_state}; run `loaf gate decide verify-accept --approve` first
diagnostic.DELIVER_SETTLE_PHASE_BYPASS: deliver from VERIFY.accept requires ceremony.settle_phase=false (standard); deep ceremony must run `loaf settle` first
diagnostic.DELIVER_VERIFY_MIN_UNAVAILABLE: verify-min was unavailable in this build (ceremony_label={ceremony_label}) — superseded at v0.1.1 by DELIVER_VERIFY_MIN_INCOMPLETE; no longer emitted
diagnostic.DELIVER_VERIFY_MIN_INCOMPLETE: verify-min: {count} done task(s) lack required evidence to deliver (ceremony_label={ceremony_label}); add evidence or waive, then re-deliver
diagnostic.DELIVER_SPIKE_TASKS: cannot deliver: task {task_id} is kind=spike (status={status}); spike tasks block delivery for the entire session
diagnostic.SETTLE_NOT_ACCEPTED: VERIFY.accept → SETTLE.lessons requires verify_accepted=true; run `loaf gate decide verify-accept --approve` before `loaf settle`
diagnostic.SPEC_LOCK_NOT_SATISFIED: SPEC.design → EXECUTE.plan requires spec_locked=true; run `loaf gate decide spec-lock --approve` before `loaf advance EXECUTE.plan`
diagnostic.TASK_NOT_CLAIMABLE: task {task_id} cannot be claimed (status={status} — terminal state)
diagnostic.TASK_DEPS_NOT_SATISFIED: task {task_id} cannot be claimed: dependency {blocking_dep} is not done (status={blocking_status})
diagnostic.TASK_NOT_CLAIMED: task {task_id} step {step} mutation requires task.status=in_progress (got status={status}); claim the task first
diagnostic.TASK_NOT_ABANDONABLE: task {task_id} cannot be abandoned (status={status} — already in a final status)
diagnostic.TASK_ABANDON_BLOCKED_DEPENDENTS: task {task_id} cannot be abandoned: non-terminal task(s) {blocking_dependents} depend on it; abandon or complete the dependents first
diagnostic.SESSION_REASON_REQUIRED: {kind}: --reason is required (the session-terminal entry must record why)
diagnostic.PROJECTION_WRITE_FAILED: {projection} projection write failed after journal append at last_seq={last_seq} (spec_version={spec_version}): {error}
diagnostic.FINDING_AMEND_SPEC_NOT_LOCKED: finding raise action=amend-spec requires state.spec_locked=true; spec is not locked at sub_state={current_sub_state}, edit directly via `loaf spec submit / add-*`
diagnostic.SPEC_VERSION_BATCH_MISMATCH: {kind}: spec_version must be {current_spec_version} at batch_index={batch_index}, got {payload_spec_version}
diagnostic.TASK_COMPLETE_PRECONDITION_VIOLATED: task {task_id} is not complete (status={status}); must-applicable steps not terminal-positive: {blocking_steps}
diagnostic.BUG_TASK_REQUIRES_RED: behavioral bug task {task_id} cannot start or complete its implement step before its RED test is registered
diagnostic.BUG_TASK_FLAG_MISUSE: task {task_id}: red_test_registered=true is valid only on a red-step task_step_done for a behavioral bug task (passed/waived result) — not on this entry
diagnostic.BUG_TASK_RED_NOT_REGISTERED: behavioral bug task {task_id} is done but never registered its RED test (red_test_registered≠true)
diagnostic.SPIKE_CONVERT_NO_SPIKE_TASK: cannot convert: the session has no non-abandoned spike task; `loaf spike convert` is a spike-task exit (protocol §8.3)
diagnostic.SNAPSHOT_STALE_REBUILD_REQUIRED: snapshot stale (reason={reason}); run `loaf doctor --rebuild --feature <feature>` to re-serialize from journal truth
diagnostic.JOURNAL_TAIL_REQUIRES_NEWER_LOAF: tail recovery refused at seq {seq}: journal kind {kind} uses entry schema {entry_schema_version} ({reason})
diagnostic.DOCTOR_MODE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: requested loaf doctor mode is not implemented in this release
diagnostic.ACTUAL_SCOPE_HISTORY_INCOMPLETE: actual scope history is incomplete: EXECUTE closure transition(s) at seq {transition_seqs} have no same-batch scope:recorded marker
diagnostic.WRITE_PATH_VIOLATION: write blocked: `{normalized_path}` is outside the allowed write paths for sub_state `{sub_state}`
diagnostic.PROTECTED_FILE_WRITE: write blocked: `{normalized_path}` matches protected_files entry `{matched_deny}` — protected files are never writable

diagnostic_fix.INPUT_FILE_NOT_FOUND: verify the path, or pass '-' to read from stdin / inline JSON starting with a JSON object or array — see `loaf <cmd> --help` for examples
diagnostic_fix.MISSING_INPUT: pass --input with one of: a JSON file path, '-' for stdin (with valid piped JSON), or inline JSON; for stdin failures, pass valid JSON to `loaf <cmd> --input -` on stdin; for the 6 schema-capable authoring commands (spec add-req / spec add-scenario / spec add-visual / tasks submit / tasks add / evidence add), run `loaf <cmd> --schema --format=json` to view the input schema
diagnostic_fix.SPEC_EDIT_INPUT_REQUIRED: pass --input with a JSON object {"body":"<Markdown>"} via file, stdin '-', or inline JSON; alternatively rerun from a terminal with both stdin and stdout attached to a TTY
diagnostic_fix.SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED: inspect the structured validation detail and correct the input or runtime state before retrying; use --schema when supported by the command to inspect its input contract
diagnostic_fix.SPEC_LOCKED_NO_DIRECT_EDIT: raise a finding with category=spec-gap (or spec-defect) and action=amend-spec to back-edge into SPEC.spec (the finding's resets_spec_locked effect lifts the gate); then retry the spec add/submit
diagnostic_fix.SPEC_NOT_INITIALIZED: run `loaf spec submit --input <file>` first to bump spec_version to 1, then retry the add-* command (SC4 will add `loaf spec init` as a separate scaffold helper that chains into submit)
diagnostic_fix.SPEC_ALREADY_INITIALIZED: edit the existing spec.md directly, or remove it before re-running `loaf spec init` (no --force flag in Slice 4)
diagnostic_fix.CONFIG_ALREADY_INITIALIZED: edit the existing config file directly, or remove it before re-running `loaf config init` (no --force flag)
diagnostic_fix.ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND: verify the path is reachable from the working directory and readable by the current user
diagnostic_fix.ATTACHMENT_NOT_FILE: attachments must be regular files; directories, symlinks to directories, sockets, and FIFOs are rejected
diagnostic_fix.FINDING_ACTION_UNUSUAL_REASON_REQUIRED: rerun with --reason explaining why this non-typical combination applies (see references/finding-matrix-rationale.md)
diagnostic_fix.FINDING_ACTION_INCOHERENT: amend the spec first (category=spec-gap / new-scope × action=amend-spec) so a target task can be planned, then raise the fix-impl / fix-test finding against that task
diagnostic_fix.FINDING_TARGET_REQUIRED: fix-impl/fix-test require --target-task + --target-step matching the action's canonical step (fix-impl=implement, fix-test=red); amend-tasks accepts an optional but valid target; amend-spec / defer / backlog must not carry a target
diagnostic_fix.PRUNE_RESTORE_NOT_FOUND: run `loaf prune --history` to list trashed sessions (slice 6b)
diagnostic_fix.PRUNE_RESTORE_AMBIGUOUS: re-run `loaf prune restore <id> --at <ts>` with one of the listed timestamps
diagnostic_fix.PRUNE_RESTORE_INCOMPLETE: inspect the trash bucket; a complete bucket has manifest.json + registry.json
diagnostic_fix.PRUNE_PATH_OCCUPIED: move or remove the occupying registry entry / feature dir, then retry restore
diagnostic_fix.PRUNE_PARTIAL_FAILURE: inspect detail.failed; rerun prune for the failed sessions after resolving the error
diagnostic_fix.MUTUALLY_EXCLUSIVE_FLAGS: pass at most one of the flags from each exclusion set; see `loaf <cmd> --help` for the canonical flag list
diagnostic_fix.INVALID_ENV_VALUE: unset {env_name} or set it to one of: {accepted}
diagnostic_fix.INVALID_FORMAT: pass --format text or --format json (the only allowed values for this release); --format=<value> equals form is accepted
diagnostic_fix.INVALID_LOCALE: unset the locale override or set it to one of: {accepted}; user preferences live in ~/.loaf/config.json locale.default_lang
diagnostic_fix.DRY_RUN_NOT_APPLICABLE: --dry-run only applies to mutating commands; re-run without --dry-run (or -n) to invoke the {command_type} command
diagnostic_fix.HOOK_EVENT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: upgrade to a loaf release that implements this hook event, OR skip this hook surface for now — `loaf hook --list-events` shows the canonical 4-event enum
diagnostic_fix.TASK_STATUS_WITHOUT_PROOF: emit `loaf evidence add` covering task_id={task_id} before advancing status (task-evidence is otherwise enforced later at verify-min / verify-accept)
diagnostic_fix.MISSING_VERIFIABILITY: add one of: measurable with metric, threshold, and optional unit/direction; verified_by_scenarios: [SCEN-...]; or acceptance_na: true with acceptance_na_reason of at least 10 characters
diagnostic_fix.VAGUE_NO_SCENARIO: either add measurable with a numeric threshold and direction, or add the verifying SCEN-id to verified_by_scenarios
diagnostic_fix.DRIVES_NOT_BOUND: add a task whose drives[] contains {req_id} (loaf tasks add --input ...), or remove the REQ if it is intentionally out-of-scope for this feature
diagnostic_fix.MUTATION_OUT_OF_RIGHTS: the mutation rights matrix (protocol.md §8.6) limits EXECUTE.plan `tasks amend` to execution[].applicability changes plus a status pending→ready advance; graph/kind-flag fields are frozen. To restructure the task graph, raise a `finding raise --action amend-tasks` back-edge, then run the sponsored `tasks add --finding` / `tasks amend --input --finding` at EXECUTE.work — a sponsored amend may change graph/definition fields but never erases execution progress (task/step status is frozen)
diagnostic_fix.LOCK_TIMEOUT: another loaf process is holding the feature lease; wait for it to release. A later writer automatically reclaims a lease only when its PID is verifiably dead and the owner generation is unchanged; malformed leases fail closed and require inspection.
diagnostic_fix.LOCK_INVALID: inspect the lease and active loaf processes; malformed leases fail closed and no loaf command deletes them. Remove or replace the file only after independently proving that no writer owns it.
diagnostic_fix.FEATURE_NOT_FOUND: run `loaf start <description>` to create a new feature, or cd into a directory that already has a .loaf/<feature>/ subtree
diagnostic_fix.FEATURE_AMBIGUOUS: disambiguate with --feature <name>, --session <UUID>, or set $LOAF_FEATURE / $LOAF_SESSION in the environment
diagnostic_fix.SESSION_CWD_MISMATCH: cd to the registered cwd before issuing the command, or pass a different --session, or drop --session to auto-pick a session in the current cwd
diagnostic_fix.SESSION_SHORT_AMBIGUOUS: pass a longer UUID prefix (≥8 chars are required; use more to disambiguate) or pass the full UUID
diagnostic_fix.SESSION_NOT_FOUND: run `loaf sessions list --in-cwd` to see registered sessions (future SC-9b), or run `loaf start <name>` to create one
diagnostic_fix.PENDING_BLOCKS_ADVANCE: resolve the head with the kind-appropriate command: `loaf gate decide <G>` for kind=gate_decision; `loaf profile escalate --confirm --input <ceremony.json>` for kind=profile_escalation; `loaf pending resolve --answer <a>` for the rest
diagnostic_fix.GATE_NOT_PENDING: resolve the current head first via the kind-appropriate command, or wait for the gate_decision pending to appear
diagnostic_fix.ESCALATION_NOT_PENDING: resolve the current head first via the kind-appropriate command, or wait for the profile_escalation pending to appear
diagnostic_fix.ACTOR_AUTHORITY_VIOLATION: use the command surface that owns this kind; human-only kinds require an interactive human actor resolved by LOAF_USER or git user.email
diagnostic_fix.FROM_CURSOR_MISMATCH: refresh the current session state and emit the transition from the actual cursor; do not replay a stale transition candidate
diagnostic_fix.INVALID_ENVELOPE: rebuild the entry through the CLI mutator so seq, entry_id, actor, kind, payload, and batch markers satisfy JournalEntry
diagnostic_fix.INVALID_PAYLOAD: fix the payload to match the PER_KIND_PAYLOAD schema for this kind and retry the mutator
diagnostic_fix.SEQ_NOT_MONOTONIC: refresh tail_seq under the session lock and retry; if the tail is corrupt run `loaf doctor --check-tail`
diagnostic_fix.SETTLE_PHASE_BYPASS: for deep profile, advance from VERIFY.accept to SETTLE.lessons via `loaf settle`; if SETTLE is not desired, start/continue a standard ceremony flow instead
diagnostic_fix.SETTLE_PHASE_DISABLED: for non-deep profiles (quick / light / standard), advance from VERIFY.accept to DONE.delivered via `loaf deliver`; to enter SETTLE, escalate ceremony to deep
diagnostic_fix.SPEC_PHASE_FORK_VIOLATION: follow the ceremony fork: spec_phase=true traverses SPEC.*, spec_phase=false goes directly to EXECUTE.plan
diagnostic_fix.SUB_STATE_AUTHORITY_VIOLATION: advance/back-edge to a sub_state that permits this journal kind, or use the command valid for the current state
diagnostic_fix.TRANSITION_ILLEGAL: choose one of the allowed forward transitions for the current sub_state, or use an explicit terminal/archive path when supported
diagnostic_fix.VERIFY_PHASE_FORK_VIOLATION: follow the ceremony fork: verify_phase=true enters VERIFY.plan, verify_phase=false can deliver after minimal verification
diagnostic_fix.EXECUTE_DONE_TASKS_NOT_FINAL: finish the remaining steps — run each task's steps via `loaf tasks step` until it auto-promotes to status=done — OR abandon out-of-scope tasks with `loaf tasks abandon <T-N> --reason "..."`, then retry `loaf advance EXECUTE.done`; see detail.non_final for the tasks still pending or in progress
diagnostic_fix.ALREADY_STARTED: resume the existing session or create a new feature directory instead of starting over initialized state
diagnostic_fix.FINDING_NOT_FOUND: list open findings and close an existing id, or raise the finding before closing it
diagnostic_fix.NO_SESSION: run `loaf start` before emitting non-bootstrap journal entries
diagnostic_fix.PENDING_NOT_FOUND: resolve the current pending head only; list pending items and retry with the head id
diagnostic_fix.REDUCER_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: implement the journal kind in the exhaustive reducer switch before appending it
diagnostic_fix.ENTRY_OVERSIZE: move long text into sidecar form via LongTextField instead of embedding it inline
diagnostic_fix.SHORT_WRITE: stop writing, preserve the journal, and run `loaf doctor --check-tail` before retrying
diagnostic_fix.TAIL_CORRUPTION: run `loaf doctor --check-tail`; do not append until the tail has been repaired or quarantined
diagnostic_fix.INVALID_ACTOR_FORMAT: set LOAF_USER to the raw human identifier without a namespace prefix, or unset it to allow interactive git user.email fallback
diagnostic_fix.NO_HUMAN_ACTOR: run interactively with git user.email configured, or set LOAF_USER explicitly
diagnostic_fix.DUPLICATE_REQ_ID: allocate a fresh REQ id under the same id_namespace (the CLI scans for max serial + 1 inside the per-session lock) or `loaf finding raise --category spec-gap --action amend-spec` if you need to retire the existing REQ
diagnostic_fix.DUPLICATE_SCEN_ID: allocate a fresh SCEN id under the same id_namespace, or amend via finding mechanism if retiring an existing scenario
diagnostic_fix.DUPLICATE_VIS_ID: allocate a fresh VIS id under the same id_namespace, or amend via finding mechanism if retiring an existing visual contract
diagnostic_fix.SPEC_FRONTMATTER_INVALID: subcode=SPEC_NOT_FOUND: run `loaf spec init` then `loaf spec submit` to seed spec.md; subcode=SPEC_YAML_INVALID: check the `---`-fenced YAML block at the top of spec.md for syntax errors; subcode=SPEC_FRONTMATTER_INVALID: run `loaf spec schema --format=json` to dump the SpecFrontmatter JSON Schema (Phase 16 SC-10) and fix the offending field. Snapshot-sourced failures require a valid canonical spec submission; initializing or editing a derived file cannot satisfy spec-lock.
diagnostic_fix.SPEC_HAS_UNCLARIFIED: edit spec.md to remove resolved needs_clarification entries, or run `loaf finding raise --category spec-gap --action clarify` to formalize the resolution flow; spec-lock check 2 requires needs_clarification === []
diagnostic_fix.TASK_NOT_FOUND: run `loaf tasks list` to see live ids; if you meant to add a new task, use `loaf tasks add` instead of amend/step; if you expected the id to exist, the projection may be stale — run `loaf doctor --rebuild` to rebuild from journal
diagnostic_fix.TASK_STEP_NOT_FOUND: use only the per-kind step names — behavioral: red/implement/refactor; structural: implement/refactor; visual-ui: mockup/implement/screenshot-compare; docs: draft/review; spike: explore/prototype/record; chore: execute. Running an unseeded step name was a silent add bug in v0.0.x — sub-cycle 3a fails fast instead
diagnostic_fix.DUPLICATE_TASK_ID: tasks_planned is whole-replacement — each task id must be unique within the batch. Rename one or merge them in the planning input
diagnostic_fix.TASKS_NOT_PLANNED: run `loaf tasks submit --input <plan-file>` to emit event:tasks_planned and seed the task graph; spec-lock check 3 and verify-accept check 4 both require tasks_based_on.spec to match the current spec.spec_version
diagnostic_fix.TASKS_BASED_ON_STALE: either re-plan tasks against the current spec via `loaf tasks submit` (whole-replacement), or amend individual tasks via `loaf tasks add/amend` + raise a `loaf finding raise --category spec-gap --action amend-spec` if a spec roll-back is needed. Surfaces for spec-lock (check 3) and verify-accept (check 4 precondition).
diagnostic_fix.REQ_NOT_DRIVEN: add a task whose drives[] array includes {req_id}, or remove the requirement from spec.md if it is no longer in scope. Note: this is the REQ-side coverage code (distinct from legacy DRIVES_NOT_BOUND which named the inverse direction)
diagnostic_fix.E2E_SCENARIO_UNBOUND: either (a) add a task with requires_acceptance=true and drives including {scenario_id}, or (b) mark the scenario with acceptance_na=<reason ≥5 chars> in spec.md if e2e acceptance is intentionally skipped for this iteration
diagnostic_fix.VISUAL_CONTRACT_UNBOUND: either (a) add a visual-ui task with visual_contract_refs including {visual_id}, or (b) mark the visual_contract with visual_na=<reason ≥5 chars> in spec.md if visual verification is intentionally deferred
diagnostic_fix.TASK_KIND_SCHEMA_VIOLATION: amend the task to satisfy its kind contract: structural/docs/spike/chore require no_test_rationale (string ≥10 chars); visual-ui requires visual_contract_refs[] with ≥1 entry. Slice C R2: bug-task RED is execution discipline, not a spec-lock obligation — a behavioral task with labels=['bug'] is born unregistered, and RED registration is enforced at runtime by BUG_TASK_REQUIRES_RED (preflight, implement step) and BUG_TASK_RED_NOT_REGISTERED (verify-accept), never by this check
diagnostic_fix.GATE_PRECONDITION_VIOLATION: this is a mutate-layer envelope around the underlying gate checks (see detail.checks for the list). spec-lock failure codes: MISSING_VERIFIABILITY / REQ_NOT_DRIVEN / E2E_SCENARIO_UNBOUND / VISUAL_CONTRACT_UNBOUND / TASKS_NOT_PLANNED / TASKS_BASED_ON_STALE / TASK_KIND_SCHEMA_VIOLATION / SPEC_HAS_UNCLARIFIED. verify-accept failure codes: VERIFY_LANE_NOT_PASSED / OPEN_FINDINGS_PRESENT / COVERAGE_NOT_SATISFIED / TASK_DONE_NO_EVIDENCE / SPEC_REVIEW_MISSING / SPEC_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTER_CONFLICT / SPEC_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTER_UNKNOWN / TASKS_NOT_PLANNED (precondition) / TASKS_BASED_ON_STALE (precondition). Fix each listed check then retry the gate decision. Pass 1.5 runs after preflight + reducer dry-run + before sidecar promotion, so a rejected gate batch leaves no on-disk residue.
diagnostic_fix.MULTIPLE_GATE_DECISIONS: split the batch — emit each gate decision as its own mutation. A batch carrying ≥2 gate approvals (even with different gate_kinds, e.g. spec-lock + verify-accept) is not a valid atomic operation. Rejected gate decisions are not counted; only approvals trigger this rule
diagnostic_fix.GATE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: use `loaf gate decide spec-lock` or `loaf gate decide verify-accept`. Future gates beyond v0.1.0 would extend the GateName enum in journal-entry.ts + evidence-schema.ts (lockstep) and wire here.
diagnostic_fix.VERIFY_LANE_NOT_PASSED: add an evidence:added entry with check={lane} (or a matching kind via the narrow fallback map: local-check/task-summary→run, verify-review/spec-review→review, acceptance→acceptance, visual-review→visual) and result one of `passed`, `approved`, or `waived`. Applicable lanes derive from spec: REQ ⇒ REVIEW, SCEN.tag=e2e ⇒ ACCEPTANCE, VIS ⇒ VISUAL, done task ⇒ RUN+REVIEW.
diagnostic_fix.OPEN_FINDINGS_PRESENT: complete the declared action for each listed finding, then run `loaf finding close <FND-id>`; if the honest disposition is carry-forward, raise it with action=defer or action=backlog instead. verify-accept excludes only open findings whose existing action declares deferral
diagnostic_fix.COVERAGE_NOT_SATISFIED: add evidence:added covering {covered_id} per protocol §5.4: REQ allows task-summary/verify-review/spec-review/manual+reason/waiver+reason; SCEN.tag=e2e allows acceptance/manual+reason/waiver+reason; VIS allows visual-review+attachment/manual+reason/waiver+reason. Result must be passed/approved/waived per §1035.
diagnostic_fix.TASK_DONE_NO_EVIDENCE: add evidence:added with covers including {task_id} and kind in the T-allowed set. Most commonly: a task-summary written on closing the task; alternatively local-check (test/lint/typecheck run), manual (human attest), or waiver (human waiver with reason ≥10 chars).
diagnostic_fix.SPEC_REVIEW_MISSING: have an independent reviewer (not the implementer of done tasks; not a cli:* automation actor) run a spec review and add an evidence:added with kind=spec-review and result `passed` or `approved`. Note: result=waived does NOT count for spec-review (kind=spec-review + result=waived bypasses the human+reason refine guarantee that kind=manual or kind=waiver provides).
diagnostic_fix.SPEC_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTER_CONFLICT: have a non-implementer (someone other than the actors on done-task task-summary/local-check evidence) submit an additional evidence with kind=spec-review and result `passed` or `approved`. One independent reviewer is sufficient — implementer self-reviews can coexist.
diagnostic_fix.SPEC_REVIEW_IMPLEMENTER_UNKNOWN: ensure at least one done-task evidence (task-summary or local-check) carries a non-cli:* actor (e.g. human:dev@example.com); the strict_spec_review comparison requires a real implementer identity to compare against. Without it, the gate cannot prove the spec reviewer is independent.
diagnostic_fix.DELIVER_NOT_ACCEPTED: run `loaf gate decide verify-accept --approve --reason "..."` first; the gate flips snapshot.state.verify_accepted before `loaf deliver` will accept the session:delivered entry
diagnostic_fix.DELIVER_SETTLE_PHASE_BYPASS: for ceremony.settle_phase=true (deep), run `loaf settle` to enter SETTLE.lessons, record lessons, then `loaf deliver`; only standard ceremony delivers directly from VERIFY.accept
diagnostic_fix.DELIVER_VERIFY_MIN_UNAVAILABLE: upgrade to v0.1.1+ where quick / light deliver runs the verify-min per-task evidence check; on failure see DELIVER_VERIFY_MIN_INCOMPLETE
diagnostic_fix.DELIVER_VERIFY_MIN_INCOMPLETE: for each listed task add evidence covering it — code tasks need a `local-check` (test/lint/typecheck) run, visual-ui needs visual-review or manual, docs needs task-summary or manual — or `loaf waive` it; then `loaf deliver` again
diagnostic_fix.DELIVER_SPIKE_TASKS: abandon the spike task (`loaf tasks abandon {task_id} --reason "..."`) or convert it to a feature (`loaf spike convert --to-feature F-N --reason "..."`); spike tasks must not remain in non-abandoned status when the session delivers
diagnostic_fix.SETTLE_NOT_ACCEPTED: run `loaf gate decide verify-accept --approve --reason "..."` before `loaf settle`; the gate flips snapshot.state.verify_accepted before the transition validator will admit the SETTLE entry
diagnostic_fix.SPEC_LOCK_NOT_SATISFIED: run `loaf gate decide spec-lock --approve --reason "..."` before `loaf advance EXECUTE.plan`; the gate runs the 8 spec-lock checks and flips snapshot.state.spec_locked before the transition validator will admit the EXECUTE.plan entry
diagnostic_fix.TASK_NOT_CLAIMABLE: tasks with status=done are already complete; status=abandoned tasks cannot be reactivated. Run `loaf tasks list` to inspect the task graph, or `loaf tasks next` to pick a different ready task
diagnostic_fix.TASK_ALREADY_CLAIMED: another worker may already hold this task; run `loaf tasks list` to inspect active claims. Stale-claim release is handled in a future slice (no CLI surface for abandon in v0.1.0 yet) — raise a finding with action=fix-impl if needed
diagnostic_fix.TASK_DEP_NOT_FOUND: add the referenced task in the same atomic batch, or amend the dependency to an existing task, then retry
diagnostic_fix.TASK_DEP_SELF: remove the self-reference from depends_on, then retry the task graph mutation
diagnostic_fix.TASK_DEP_DUPLICATE: keep each dependency id only once in depends_on, then retry
diagnostic_fix.TASK_DEP_CYCLE: remove or redirect one dependency in the reported closed path, then retry
diagnostic_fix.TASK_DEP_ABANDONED: use an amend-tasks-sponsored task amendment to replace the abandoned dependency, then retry
diagnostic_fix.TASK_DEPS_NOT_SATISFIED: complete deps_on tasks first (run `loaf tasks list --status pending` to see what is blocking), or use `loaf tasks next` to pick a task with all deps satisfied
diagnostic_fix.TASK_NOT_CLAIMED: run `loaf tasks claim {task_id}` to move the task from pending/ready to in_progress before emitting task_step_started or task_step_done; once auto-promoted to done, steps cannot be re-mutated
diagnostic_fix.TASK_NOT_ABANDONABLE: tasks with status=done are already complete and status=abandoned tasks are already abandoned; run `loaf tasks list` to inspect the task graph and abandon a non-terminal task instead
diagnostic_fix.TASK_ABANDON_BLOCKED_DEPENDENTS: abandon or complete the dependent tasks first (see detail.blocking_dependents), then retry `loaf tasks abandon {task_id} --reason "..."`; abandoning a parent would strand a pending child
diagnostic_fix.SESSION_REASON_REQUIRED: re-run with `--reason "..."`; `loaf archive` and `loaf abandon` both require a rationale on the journal entry
diagnostic_fix.PROJECTION_WRITE_FAILED: the journal already records the change; do NOT retry the same command. Run `loaf doctor --rebuild` (when available) to resync derived projections from journal truth, or inspect `.loaf/<feature>/journal.jsonl` tail manually.
diagnostic_fix.FINDING_AMEND_SPEC_NOT_LOCKED: drop --action amend-spec and use `loaf spec submit` / `loaf spec add-req` / etc. directly while spec is unlocked; amend-spec is reserved for post-`gate decide spec-lock --approve` recovery.
diagnostic_fix.SPEC_VERSION_NOT_MONOTONIC: set spec_version to {expected_spec_version} in the input payload (or omit it and let `loaf spec submit` fill the current+1 default).
diagnostic_fix.SPEC_VERSION_BATCH_MISMATCH: in a multi-entry spec batch, the head (batch_index=0) bumps spec_version to current+1 and all continuation entries (batch_index≥1) must set spec_version to that same value. Check the head entry's payload.spec_version and align companions.
diagnostic_fix.TASK_COMPLETE_PRECONDITION_VIOLATED: finish each blocking step via `loaf tasks step start/done`; a task auto-promotes to status=done once every must-applicable step is passed/waived/na, and `loaf tasks complete` then confirms it. Run `loaf tasks list` to inspect step status.
diagnostic_fix.BUG_TASK_REQUIRES_RED: run `loaf tasks register-red {task_id}` once the failing RED test is in place; protocol §9.3 requires RED registration before the implement step of a behavioral task labelled `bug`.
diagnostic_fix.BUG_TASK_FLAG_MISUSE: do not set red_test_registered in a planned task or on a non-red step; the flag is owned by `loaf tasks register-red`, which the reducer promotes to task-level registration.
diagnostic_fix.BUG_TASK_RED_NOT_REGISTERED: a done behavioral bug task must have registered its RED test via `loaf tasks register-red`; this is a verify-accept defense-in-depth check for raw-API journals — rebuild the journal or register RED retroactively before re-running the gate.
diagnostic_fix.SPIKE_CONVERT_NO_SPIKE_TASK: run `loaf spike convert` only from a session that holds a kind=spike task; for a non-spike session close it with `loaf archive --reason "..."` or `loaf abandon --reason "..."`
diagnostic_fix.SNAPSHOT_STALE_REBUILD_REQUIRED: snapshot meta/leaves no longer agree with the journal tail; run `loaf doctor --rebuild --feature <feature>` to re-serialize from journal truth, then retry. Inspect detail.reason + reason-specific fields (meta_path / projection_kind / cause) to triage corruption source before rebuilding.
diagnostic_fix.JOURNAL_TAIL_REQUIRES_NEWER_LOAF: preserve journal.jsonl byte-for-byte and upgrade loaf to a version that understands this entry before running tail recovery again
diagnostic_fix.INVALID_PRESET: Use one of quick, light, standard, or deep.
diagnostic_fix.USAGE: Run the command with --help and retry with the required flags/arguments.
diagnostic_fix.DOCTOR_MODE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Use loaf doctor --rebuild --feature <name>; other doctor modes are deferred.
diagnostic_fix.DOCTOR_FEATURE_REQUIRED: Pass --feature <name> or --feature-dir <path> for the session to rebuild.
diagnostic_fix.DOCTOR_REBUILD_FAILED: Inspect the emitted error message; fix the journal/projection issue, then rerun doctor --rebuild.
diagnostic_fix.REDUCER_ERROR: Preserve the journal and command stderr; this indicates a loaf-cli bug or inconsistent projection state.
diagnostic_fix.APPEND_ERROR: preserve journal.jsonl and the emitted detail, then inspect the append error before retrying; if a write may have started, run `loaf doctor` to verify journal integrity
diagnostic_fix.SIDECAR_ERROR: inspect the emitted error and attachment path permissions; validation already passed, so remove any orphan sidecar residue before retrying
diagnostic_fix.INVALID_BATCH: rebuild the batch through the CLI mutator without caller-owned envelope fields and with entries + meta matching the current journal tail
diagnostic_fix.SCOPE_RECORDED_BATCH_INVALID: emit at most one scope:recorded immediately before exactly one EXECUTE.work to EXECUTE.done transition in the same batch
diagnostic_fix.SCOPE_RECORDED_ITERATION_DUPLICATE: reuse the recorded closure result for this iteration or advance through a finding back-edge before recording a new closure
diagnostic_fix.ACTUAL_SCOPE_HISTORY_INCOMPLETE: do not fabricate an empty actual_scope; preserve the journal and rerun the feature's EXECUTE work with an F-027-capable loaf version before auditing scope. Pre-F-027 closure scope cannot be reconstructed from journal history.
diagnostic_fix.WRITE_PATH_VIOLATION: write within the current step's contract, advance to the right sub_state/step first, or widen the matching `paths.*` category in .loaf/.config/loaf.config.json
diagnostic_fix.PROTECTED_FILE_WRITE: remove the entry from protected_files in .loaf/.config/loaf.config.json if the protection is wrong, otherwise write a different file

help.start: Begin a new feature session in .loaf/<feature>/
help.status: Print current state.json + artifact health summary
help.next: Compute the next owner command for the current session
help.advance: Run next transition + diff guard (git status + write_paths AND-merge)
help.resume: Resume session from a handoff pack
help.handoff: Write resume-pack.json for context overflow handoff
help.spec_submit: Validate spec.md against SpecFrontmatter schema and record (strict).
help.spec_init: Scaffold a spec.md template ready for $EDITOR
help.tasks_submit: Validate tasks.json against discriminated-union TaskKind schema
help.tasks_register_red: Register failing test for a behavioral-bug task (required before implement)
help.evidence_add: Append a new evidence entry; auto-assign EV-id
help.waive: Record a waiver evidence; actor must start with human: and reason must be >=10 chars
help.finding_raise: Raise a finding (VERIFY.* always, EXECUTE.* only post-spec-lock)
help.verify_status: Compute current verify check applicability + status (real-time)
help.gate_decide: Record human gate decision; writes evidence kind=gate-decision
help.amend: Edit spec or tasks pre-lock (rejected post-lock; use findings instead)
help.deliver: Close session as DONE.delivered (advisory only; no git/gh side effects)
help.check: Schema-only check for a given artifact or path (CI usage)
help.doctor: Self-diagnose loaf-cli installation, repo layout, config
